name: QiYi DNA Cube 3x3 (Concave)
description: More than just a cube, the QiYi DNA Cube (Concave) is a work of art. Along with vibrant stickerless bright shades, this puzzle also features an intricately molded, lattice design on each of the pieces as well as a novel, concave shape. This is a 3x3 with a fantastic design on the outside, which also has a good speed solving mechanism on the inside.
